```yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: Namespace
metadata:
  name: sock-shop
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Secret
metadata:
  name: catalogue-db-secret
  namespace: sock-shop
type: Opaque
stringData:
  MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD: "fake_password_change_me"
---
# FRONT-END
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: front-end
  namespace: sock-shop
  labels:
    name: front-end
spec:
  ports:
    - port: 8079
      targetPort: 8079
      name: http
  selector:
    name: front-end
---
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: front-end
  namespace: sock-shop
  labels:
    name: front-end
spec:
  replicas: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      name: front-end
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        name: front-end
    spec:
      containers:
        - name: front-end
          image: weaveworksdemos/front-end:0.3.12
          ports:
            - containerPort: 8079
          resources:
            limits:
              cpu: 300m
              memory: 300Mi
            requests:
              cpu: 100m
              memory: 100Mi
          securityContext:
            readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
            capabilities:
              drop:
                - ALL
---
# EDGE-ROUTER
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: edge-router
  namespace: sock-shop
  labels:
    name: edge-router
spec:
  type: LoadBalancer
  ports:
    - port: 80
      targetPort: 80
      name: http
    - port: 8080
      targetPort: 8080
      name: mgmt
  selector:
    name: edge-router
---
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: edge-router
  namespace: sock-shop
  labels:
    name: edge-router
spec:
  replicas: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      name: edge-router
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        name: edge-router
    spec:
      containers:
        - name: edge-router
          image: weaveworksdemos/edge-router:0.1.1
          ports:
            - containerPort: 80
            - containerPort: 8080
          resources:
            limits:
              cpu: 200m
              memory: 200Mi
            requests:
              cpu: 100m
              memory: 100Mi
          securityContext:
            readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
            capabilities:
              drop:
                - ALL
              add:
                - NET_BIND_SERVICE
                - CHOWN
                - SETGID
                - SETUID
                - DAC_OVERRIDE
          volumeMounts:
            - mountPath: /var/run
              name: var-run-tmpfs
      volumes:
        - name: var-run-tmpfs
          emptyDir: {}
---
# CATALOGUE
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: catalogue
  namespace: sock-shop
  labels:
    name: catalogue
spec:
  ports:
    - port: 80
      targetPort: 80
      name: http
  selector:
    name: catalogue
---
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: catalogue
  namespace: sock-shop
  labels:
    name: catalogue
spec:
  replicas: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      name: catalogue
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        name: catalogue
    spec:
      containers:
        - name: catalogue
          image: weaveworksdemos/catalogue:0.3.5
          ports:
            - containerPort: 80
          resources:
            limits:
              cpu: 200m
              memory: 200Mi
            requests:
              cpu: 100m
              memory: 100Mi
          securityContext:
            readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
            capabilities:
              drop:
                - ALL
              add:
                - NET_BIND_SERVICE
---
# CATALOGUE-DB
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: catalogue-db
  namespace: sock-shop
  labels:
    name: catalogue-db
spec:
  ports:
    - port: 3306
      targetPort: 3306
      name: mysql
  selector:
    name: catalogue-db
---
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: catalogue-db
  namespace: sock-shop
  labels:
    name: catalogue-db
spec:
  replicas: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      name: catalogue-db
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        name: catalogue-db
    spec:
      containers:
        - name: catalogue-db
          image: weaveworksdemos/catalogue-db:0.3.0
          ports:
            - containerPort: 3306
          env:
            - name: MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD
              valueFrom:
                secretKeyRef:
                  name: catalogue-db-secret
                  key: MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD
            - name: MYSQL_ALLOW_EMPTY_PASSWORD
              value: "true"
            - name: MYSQL_DATABASE
              value: socksdb
          resources:
            limits:
              cpu: 500m
              memory: 512Mi
            requests:
              cpu: 250m
              memory: 256Mi
---
# CARTS
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: carts
  namespace: sock-shop
  labels:
    name: carts
spec:
  ports:
    - port: 80
      targetPort: 80
      name: http
  selector:
    name: carts
---
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: carts
  namespace: sock-shop
  labels:
    name: carts
spec:
  replicas: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      name: carts
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        name: carts
    spec:
      containers:
        - name: carts
          image: weaveworksdemos/carts:0.4.8
          ports:
            - containerPort: 80
          env:
            - name: JAVA_OPTS
              value: "-Xms64m -Xmx128m -XX:+UseG1GC -Djava.security.egd=file:/dev/urandom -Dspring.zipkin.enabled=false"
          resources:
            limits:
              cpu: 500m
              memory: 500Mi
            requests:
              cpu: 250m
              memory: 250Mi
          securityContext:
            readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
            capabilities:
              drop:
                - ALL
              add:
                - NET_BIND_SERVICE
          volumeMounts:
            - mountPath: /tmp
              name: tmp-volume
      volumes:
        - name: tmp-volume
          emptyDir: {}
---
# CARTS-DB
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: carts-db
  namespace: sock-shop
  labels:
    name: carts-db
spec:
  ports:
    - port: 27017
      targetPort: 27017
      name: mongo
  selector:
    name: carts-db

spec:
  replicas: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      name: carts-db
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        name: carts-db
    spec:
      containers:
        - name: carts-db

            - containerPort: 27017

            limits:

            capabilities:
              drop:
                - ALL

                - CHOWN
                - SETGID
                - SETUID
          volumeMounts:
            - mountPath: /tmp
              name: tmp-volume
      volumes:
        - name: tmp-volume
          emptyDir: {}
---
```
